text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Yo, did you have fun at summer camp?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
"I have some news! Thanks to everyone 
doing their island training this summer, 
we've gathered a massive amount of 
reports!"

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
And so, development has made huuuuge 
progress! I'd like to ask you to trial the 
island training again!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
It's not a bad deal for you either, right? 
Come by anytime!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Let's visit again in the future for 
another round of island training!
